---
title: "About"
---

We plan dinners at home for family and friends. Every dinner gets its own theme and its own menu card. This site keeps them all in one place.

## Recipes and credits

Some dishes come from cookbooks. For those we list the book, the author, and the page, and describe what we changed in general terms. We don't reproduce recipes from books here. If a dish catches your eye, the book is worth buying.

Dishes we made up ourselves may include the full recipe.
